views.rationale: AMZN's 19% growth in service sales outpaced BAC's 1% growth in sales and trading revenue.
BA's 6% increase in cost of sales was less than CAT's 20% increase in sales and revenues.
GOOGL's revenue growth rate could decline over time, while JNJ's sales increased 6.7% in 2018.
GOOGL's revenue growth rate could decline over time, while KO's net operating revenues decreased 10% in 2018.
GS's net revenues were $36.62 billion in 2018, while JPM's net interest income was $55.1 billion, up 10%.

NVDA's revenue increased 100.0% in 2019, whereas NEE's operating revenues decreased $286 million in 2018.
PG's gross margin decreased 100 basis points to 48.9% of net sales in 2019, whereas UNH's Optum segments reported increased revenues and earnings from operations.
